d:
Pichhle 10 varshon men jalvayu parivartan ke karan har din austan 70,000 log visthapit hue hain. yah sanyukt rashtr ki sharnarthi ejensi- yuenaechsiaar ka aankra hai. garib desh iski sabse zyada mar jhel rahe hain.
In logon ko suraksha dene ke lie koee vaishvik qanuni dhancha maujud nahin hai. jalvayu ke karan hone vale visthapan ko jineva kanvenshan ke tahat sharan ka vaidh aadhar nahin mana jata. ab, laitin amerika, prashant kshetr aur eshiya men tin desh aise hain jo unhen prabhavit kar rahi aapat sthiti ka samna karne ke lie qadam utha rahe hain.
